dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored rings with irregular, scalloped high-contrast perimeters. The transition from the dark brown dorsal fur to the light beige annulus edge is sharp, particularly in the mid-upper dorsal region where 3-5 distinct rings exhibit jagged outer perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid light-colored pixel clusters located primarily in the interstices between the larger macro-annuli. These clusters show minimal internal gradient and are concentrated most heavily along the central longitudinal axis of the visible torso.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent circular annuli in the upper-central region form an irregular obtuse triangle. A fourth keypoint, defined by a large 'C' shaped structure in the upper-right quadrant, lies at a distance roughly twice the radius of the central-most annulus.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, raw, red/maroon colored lesion on the left anterior section (neck/shoulder area). The anomaly shows jagged margins and visible underlying tissue texture, contrasting sharply with the surrounding dark fur.
